items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: I don't remember Tommy Diggs either.

ctx.x: Sam. Oh, there's a fine team right there.
Edith Fellas. Do you remember her? No, I don't. I don't remember Tommy Diggs either.
Oh, there was a gorgeous gal. Doris Drew. Mm-hmm. At the Blue Room. Sweet, kind, and friendly. Mm-hmm.
